title: FIFO queue
contract: A sequential reference history for an abstract FIFO queue returns values in insertion order.
scope: All operation sequences length 0..4 of enqueue 0, enqueue 1, dequeue; sequential histories only, not linearizability.
assumptions: Exactly the abstract finite model and input domain described in scope; no claim about LLMLang implementation or unbounded executions.

obligations.claim: Each dequeue equals earliest unmatched enqueue or empty sentinel; final queue matches remaining items.
